about: B4 execution design v0.5/v0.6: everything about a delegated card except its brief comes from here, never from a model. Seats claude-code and codex only (grok-cli is not a card family). The review profile is the other family's seat. Caps are per card, in USD; the B4 Dev total is held to $10 by the worker's spend reservation. Routes and units are the Dev authority's (authority.dev.json, checked 5 Nov): claude-code.subscription in usd_notional (at most 2.0 per item), codex.subscription in minutes (at most 30 per item).
